title: Coni's Crates
body:
# Coni's Crates

Coni's Crates is a simple bulk storage mod which adds Crates. Crates are storage blocks only accessible via hoppers, or blocks added by other mods which act similar to hoppers. Crates also support using redstone comparators with them. there are six tiers of Crates available in survival:



- Wooden Crate
- Copper Crate
- Iron Crate
- Golden Crate
- Diamond Crate
- Netherite Crate

The number of items you can fit in a crate increases the higher the tier. However this is not the case for the Creative Crate, where whichever item is funneled into it will get duplicated infinitely.

The mod is currently available for Neoforge ONLY. A fabric port will come in the future.
